apps.whats_new:
48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.36.4 - THE PRAYER GROUPS EDITED IN THE PORTAL (and Website Update 78)
  - In the member portal (Ministry → Meetings → Prayer groups → ✎ Edit the groups), the secretary (or whoever makes the
    groups of that meeting) can swap two people, move someone to another group, take someone out of the groups with a note
    (e.g. "playing the keyboard") and put them back. A change counts from the round shown on.
  - Here, Meetings… → Prayer groups shows "Not in a group" with the note (or "came late, not placed yet"). Someone taken
    out is not added with "Add the late arrivals" and stays out when the groups are made again.
  - This program's copy of the portal page: Website Update 78 (rules version 47, unchanged).
